judged.what: 100T bang secures a round-closing kill, prompting the streamer to repeatedly shout 'GET HIM OUT OF THERE!' and taunt the opponent.
judged.reason: This is a routine single kill to win a round. Although he uses his signature 'GET HIM OUT OF THERE!' catchphrase with high energy, standard kills without a multi-kill or clutch do not make for a high-priority clip.
